I have implemented the feature flag rollout for the frontend stable chunk build.

### Summary of Changes

1. **Feature Flag Resolution & Decision Precedence** in [`posthog/stable_chunks.py`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/posthog-posthog-flash-systematic-0/posthog/stable_chunks.py)
   - Defined [`STABLE_CHUNKS_FLAG`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/posthog-posthog-flash-systematic-0/posthog/stable_chunks.py#L29) (`"stable-chunk-names"`).
   - Replaced `stable_chunks_opted_in` with [`stable_chunks_choice(request, feature_flags)`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/posthog-posthog-flash-systematic-0/posthog/stable_chunks.py#L62):
     - **Query parameter:** `?stable_chunks=1` forces the stable build; any other parameter value (e.g. `0` or `fallback`) forces the current build.
     - **Stored cookie:** If `ph_stable_chunks` is set to `"0"` or `"1"`, it outranks the flag for subsequent visits.
     - **Feature flag:** If unauthenticated (`not request.user.is_authenticated`) or without feature flags, defaults to `False`. For authenticated users without a manual override, evaluates `feature_flags.get(STABLE_CHUNKS_FLAG) is True` so a 50% rollout splits logged-in users evenly.
   - Updated [`persist_stable_chunks_choice(request, response)`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/posthog-posthog-flash-systematic-0/posthog/stable_chunks.py#L88) to store both `"0"` and `"1"` in the cookie for 30 days when specified via query parameter, while ignoring non-choice values like `fallback`.

2. **Bootstrapped Flag Evaluation Consistency** in [`posthog/utils.py`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/posthog-posthog-flash-systematic-0/posthog/utils.py)
   - Updated [`_build_template_context`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/posthog-posthog-flash-systematic-0/posthog/utils.py#L744) to pass `posthog_bootstrap.get("featureFlags")` into [`stable_chunks_for_request`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/posthog-posthog-flash-systematic-0/posthog/stable_chunks.py#L82). This guarantees the server serves the build matching the exact feature flag values injected into the in-page client for `$web_vitals` LCP tracking.

3. **Fallback Loop Prevention & Re-enrollment** in [`common/esbuilder/utils.mjs`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/posthog-posthog-flash-systematic-0/common/esbuilder/utils.mjs)
   - Updated [`copyIndexHtml`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/posthog-posthog-flash-systematic-0/common/esbuilder/utils.mjs#L71) runtime fallback handling to redirect to `?stable_chunks=fallback` upon a stable chunk loading error. This immediately serves the current build for that page load without saving a 30-day opt-out cookie, allowing subsequent navigations to continue participating in the experiment.

4. **Unit & Integration Tests** in [`posthog/test/test_stable_chunks.py`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/posthog-posthog-flash-systematic-0/posthog/test/test_stable_chunks.py)
   - Expanded [`TestStableChunks.test_choice_precedence`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/posthog-posthog-flash-systematic-0/posthog/test/test_stable_chunks.py#L65) across all permutations of query parameter, cookie, feature flag status, and authentication state (verifying anonymous users are never enrolled via the flag).
   - Added [`TestStableChunksChoiceSurvivesTheRequest.test_the_flag_picks_the_build_it_bootstraps`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/posthog-posthog-flash-systematic-0/posthog/test/test_stable_chunks.py#L121) to verify that template context generation correctly honors the bootstrapped flag and falls back to the current build when flag evaluation is absent or fails.
